Definition: from G4298; progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively):--furtherance, profit.
BiblicalUsage: Prokope is progress, advancement, furtherance. Paul says his bonds fell out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel, and tells Timothy to meditate on these things that his profiting may appear to all.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even chains can further the gospel, and progress is measured by the gospel's advance, not mine.
